{{Quote|We're hearing all sorts of noise coming from the Tyyyn nebula. I worry that another transport has come under fire.|[[Eyma]], to a [[Civilian Protection Guild|CPG]] pilot|<ref name="SWG:TGSA" />}}
The ''Vue'zae'' was a civilian [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] in service during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TGSA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the ''Vue'zae'' was traveling in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] when it was attacked by the [[Ghrag Mercenaries]] in the [[Tyyyn Nebula]]. The [[Civilian Protection Guild]] therefore dispatched a group of [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to rescue the damaged transport. The CPG [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] destroyed several Ghrag pirates and docked with the ''Vue'zae'' to deliver a new [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]]. The ''Vue'zae'' was then escorted by the CPG to the [[Kashyyyk Space Station]] until it finally left the system.<ref name="SWG:TGSA" />
